environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind CloudFront distribution (d1234abcdef.cloudfront.net). Origin is an internal ALB (scheme=internal) in private subnets with security group sg-0def456 allowing ingress ONLY from the CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing, pl-3b927c52). CloudFront distribution has a custom origin header X-Origin-Verify with a rotating secret managed by Secrets Manager automatic rotation (every 4 hours). The ALB has a listener rule that returns HTTP 403 for any request missing the correct X-Origin-Verify header value. FLASK_DEBUG=0 in this environment. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution uses a cache behavior with Viewer Protocol Policy: HTTPS Only, and a CloudFront Function at viewer-request stage that strips all query parameters except 'expires' and 'sig' from /api/debug/* paths, effectively preventing parameter-based information disclosure. The APP_SIGNING_KEY is stored in Secrets Manager (not SSM) with resource policy restricting access to the task execution role only.

config.SIGNING_KEY_ACCESS: task execution role only via Secrets Manager resource policy
